definitions.gloss: thorough knowledge; being well acquainted with; knowing inside out
definitions.explanation: Deep, thorough familiarity with a subject, place, or situation gained through extensive experience or study.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{熟知|じゅくち}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He knows this area inside and out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{熟知|じゅくち}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I consulted a lawyer well versed in the law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{熟知|じゅくち}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧でなければ、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Only someone with thorough knowledge of the situation on the ground could make this decision.

notes:
Implies knowledge gained through deep engagement, not just superficial familiarity. The {熟|じゅく} component means "mature" or "thorough," giving the word a sense of mastery through experience. Often used to describe professionals or experts who have internalized their knowledge.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{熟知|じゅくち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to know the circumstances thoroughly
- ⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{熟知|じゅくち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to know the industry inside out
- {熟知|じゅくち}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: with thorough knowledge of
- ⟦{内情|ないじょう}→内情：25305_naijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{熟知|じゅくち}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: to know the inside story

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{精通|せいつう}→精通：15453_seitsuu⟧: being well versed — similar depth, often used for academic or technical expertise
- ⟦{知|し}り→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧: to know everything about — more colloquial, emphasizes completeness
- ⟦{博識|はくしき}→博識：21871_hakushiki⟧: wide knowledge, erudition — emphasizes breadth rather than depth
- ⟦{通暁|つうぎょう}→通暁：24396_tsuugyou⟧: mastery, thorough understanding — more formal and literary
